programme.title: Arvin Mitchell
programme.desc: With an array of impressions, stories, gestures and faces, Arvin's memorable performance is sure to please. As the former co-host of BET's Club Comic View, Arvin has been featured on Kevin Heart's “One Mic Stand”, Tony Rocks “The Funny Spot” as well as entertaining our troops abroad. Nominated as one of NBC's Stand Up for Diversity top comics Arvin continues to tour colleges, clubs, cruise ships & churches.

programme.title: Zoltan Kaszas
programme.desc: Zoltan Kaszas was born in Budapest, Hungary and raised in San Diego, California. He first stepped onstage at the age of nineteen and he was hooked immediately. Zoltan's diverse background and life experience along with his conversational storytelling style has been entertaining audiences at comedy clubs and colleges across the country. His comedy has also been featured on the television show Laughs on FOX, on radio at SiriusXM in print in The Atlantic and has helped him win The Seattle International Comedy Competition &The San Diego Comedy Festival. When he isn't traveling the world Zoltan can be found at home with his wife Brittany and their cat Jessica, you can keep up with him on his weekly podcast available on iTunes called This Week In Zoltan.

programme.title: Brian Moote
programme.desc: Brian Moote started performing stand up in 2005 while he was working as a teacher in the Seattle School District. He then went to graduate school to get a masters degree in social work because who doesn't love crippling debt? I mean, this is America. After graduating he moved to LA and now tours the country telling jokes. He has made TV appearances on the USA Network's "Characters Welcome," Nickelodeon's "Nickmom's Nite Out," MTV's "Money from Strangers" and AXS TV's "Gotham Live." You should come out and see him tell jokes... DO IT!!!

programme.title: Mike Speenberg
programme.desc: Mike Speenberg has been a professional touring Stand-up comedian for 20 years. He's performed on 5 different continents, entertained everyone from Hall of Fame Athletes to US Diplomats, shared the stage with everyone from Robin Williams to Bill Burr, and been featured on everything from CNN to the AMERICAN FORCES RADIO NETWORK.

programme.title: Andrew Rivers
programme.desc: Andrew's very personal and fun storytelling comedy, combined with his exemplary work ethic has earned him high praise from some of the best comedians in the business. Andrew is a featured writer, actor, and comedian on the TV show “UpLate NW.” Andrew has been featured on NBC, FOX, and the Bob & Tom Radio Show and is a regular opening act for Christopher Titus. Andrew was also featured on the popular Buzzfeed web series “Truth or Drink“, has performed in over 35 states and his new podcast called “Don't Quit Your Night Job” was featured in the Seattle Times.

programme.title: Collin Moulton
programme.desc: Collin is one of the most fun, personable, and sought after headliners today. He has had his own stand-up special on SHOWTIME, he's been on NICKELODEON, and was recently featured on LAST CALL WITH CARSON DALY. Touring for over 15 years Collin has gained an ease and enjoyment on stage that makes every show worth watching.America knows and loves him. His familiarity and energy engages and relieves the audience before he even speaks. His electric storytelling style makes you care about every topic he explores. Collin's comedy is the release needed from our every day lives. Come needing to laugh tonight, leave wanting to laugh forever!Collin Moulton

programme.title: Costaki Economopoulos
programme.desc: For 20 years Costaki has been living his dream as a full-time stand up comic. He has written jokes for Bette Midler, Jay Leno, MTV, and BET. You may have seen him on Showtime or heard him on Sirius, but you probably know him best from his regular appearances on the nationally syndicated Bob & Tom Radio Show.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "The Great Escape"
programme.desc: Kavi is released and disappears into the city, whilst Zamir and his new gang raid an office. The monkey catcher traps the troop’s alpha male, Vasu, leaving Zamir set for leadership.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "Trading Places"
programme.desc: Zamir and his new troop raid a jewelry store and break into a hotel store room leading to a run-in with little Kavi, who becomes the troop’s latest recruit.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "Rising Forces"
programme.desc: Policing langurs patrol Delhi’s streets and the Holi festival of colour interrupts Zamir’s attempt to take over control of Galta temple.

programme.title: Animal Armory S1 - "MASTERS OF DISGUISE"
programme.desc: These creatures share an amazing trait, the ability use the environment surrounding them to hide in plain sight, to virtually disappear and be utterly camouflaged.

programme.title: Animal Armory S1 - "LETHAL & POISON"
programme.desc: These creatures all utilize venom and poison to attack, defend and hunt, with devastating results.

programme.title: Animal Armory S1 - "SPITS & STINGS"
programme.desc: These creatures have evolved to incorporate spitting and stinging into their deadly arsenal for surviving in the wild.

programme.title: Wild Walk S1 - "!Khwa ttu"
programme.desc: Swati walks in the footsteps of the san, the early hunter gatherers of southern Africa. Come to !Khwa ttu, to learn about their history, culture and why they are some of the world’s first passionate conservationists.

programme.title: Wild Walk S1 - "Kelp Forest"
programme.desc: Enter the underwater golden forests and walk the beaches between the intertidal zones as Swati discovers the amazing but fast depleting biodiversity of the world's wildest coastline in the cape of storms.

programme.title: Wild Walk S1 - "Leopards"
programme.desc: Walk with leopards as Swati travels to the Cederburg mountains to learn about the cape leopard, to question what puts leopards in conflict with people and what the solutions to this conflict might be?

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "De Hoop Marine Protected Area"
programme.desc: In this episode Tali explores the various creatures that reside in De Hoop Marine Protected Area, from the Greater White Pelicans and Chacma baboons to the large Eland.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Cape Agulhas"
programme.desc: Cape Agulhas is the true meeting place of the Atlantic and Indian Oceans, a place of immense cultural and natural value. Tali searches for answers to her burning questions about establishing new parks and the roles communities play in this process.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Cedarberg Biodiversity"
programme.desc: Using a novel conservation model, the Greater Cedarberg Biodiversity Initiative is ensuring that the land is used in an efficient way, with the land and its inhabitants work in harmony. Tali investigate the various ways being used to achieve this.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Cape Floristic Region"
programme.desc: Tali investigates the struggle to protect the Cape Floristic Region, one of the world’s 6 floral kingdoms and the only one entirely within the borders of a single country. She finds out more about why this region is in critical need of conservation.

programme.title: Echo And The Elephants Of Amboseli S1 - "Clash of the Titans"
programme.desc: The rains bring new life. Lush new grass is saving the 58 elephant families from hunger. An extraordinary annual reunion brings hundreds of elephants together in scenes of celebration, play and romance.

programme.title: Echo And The Elephants Of Amboseli S1 - "The Drama of Big Ed"
programme.desc: Nine months of drought have given way to longed-for rains. The elephants now have enough to eat. Echo is taking the family on a day out to the Snipe River. Isaiah’s spear wound needs urgent treatment. But the elephants are ruining new crops.

programme.title: Echo And The Elephants Of Amboseli S1 - "Cynthia's Choice"
programme.desc: After months of hunger, Echo’s family are enjoying good times. The matriarch and her family are dustbathing at the safe home where Echo shelters her young. Even when they run to defend themselves, they are only pretending to be attacked!

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Gentle Giants"
programme.desc: For this episode we will travel to the Entabeni Safari Conservancy where a special family of African elephant awaits relocation. The family will be moved from a private conservation area as they have reached the carrying capacity of that area.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "Impala"
programme.desc: With a high reproduction rate that leads to large numbers on reserves and are the staple diet for predators that keep their numbers in check. See how these highly adapted and unique animals get loaded and gently treated to “migrate” to a new home.

programme.title: Modern Migrations S1 - "White Rhino"
programme.desc: Another member of Africa’s Big 5 - the white rhino. Once on the brink of extinction, and today thanks to the conservation and breeding strategies, there are enough to relocate to other nature reserves to ensure the survival of this unique species.

programme.title: Wild About S1 - "Raptors"
programme.desc: Many of the larger breeds of raptors are now endangered or vulnerable, particularly eagles, vultures and larger owls as they require large, specialized habitats. Though they may be soaring high now, the future doesn’t bode well for the great raptors.

programme.title: Wild About S1 - "Apes"
programme.desc: All great apes are highly endangered partly due to hunting and illegal pet trade, but mainly due to shrinking habitats. Sitting in the tree tops and jungles is a reminder of our past and our responsibilities for the future.

programme.title: Wild About S1 - "Spiders"
programme.desc: Commonly feared, spiders nevertheless persist in every part of the world in great numbers. Spiders are among the biggest groups of invertebrates with over 43,000 species.

programme.title: Python Hunters S3 - "Death by Viper"
programme.desc: Back-to-back cold winters have been keeping Florida’s Burmese python population in check so the hunters head to Costa Rica to tangle with the region’s deadliest venomous snakes and soon find themselves on an American crocodile rescue mission.

programme.title: Python Hunters S3 - "Amazon Anaconda"
programme.desc: Putting everything on the line, the hunters head to Peru where they go off-road and off the map in search of the mighty green anaconda. Shawn has spent more than a decade exploring the jungles of Peru, buying land, and building a home away from home.

programme.title: Python Hunters S3 - "Stalking the Anaconda"
programme.desc: After tracking down the green anaconda in Peru’s Amazon basin, the hunters are determined to find another rare prize – the legendary black caiman. These elusive predators can grow up to 18 feet long, and their jungle habitat is too dangerous.

programme.title: Outback Vet S2 - "Shark Mission"
programme.desc: Ed and Dunc launch a post-lockdown mission to restock their aquarium, while Rick uses a pub forklift to weigh a massive Rottweiler.

programme.title: Outback Vet S2 - "The Trip of Two Turtles"
programme.desc: Dr. Katy coordinates the release of two endangered Hawksbill turtles, an amputee pup beats the odds, and Ed sources sustainable squid.

programme.title: Outback Vet S2 - "A Dingo get DNA-ed"
programme.desc: A Great Dane steps up for a critical blood transfusion in the clinic, while Rick tracks down a wild dingo in the outback for a DNA test.

programme.title: To The Rescue S2 - "The Lucky Ones"

programme.title: To The Rescue S2 - "Detroit Dog Rescue"

programme.title: Zoo Clues S3 - "Animal Athletes"

programme.title: Zoo Clues S3 - "Dog 101"

programme.title: Zoo Clues S3 - "World’s Showiest Animals"

programme.desc: Esha gets lost and Kavi finds his way back to the Galta gang at last. Zamir’s army attacks the Temple and Tarak is seriously injured in the battle.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "A New Dawn"
programme.desc: Tarak is found dead and Kamal faces the prospect of leading the Galta Gang. Zamir attack's the temple again but is finally caught by the monkey catcher. New babies are born into the Galta Gang, but Zamir has also left a legacy in the city - twins!

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S2 - "Divided We Stand"
programme.desc: As the troop expands and the economy plunges, scarce offerings at the temple leave the macaques competing with each other for sustenance.

programme.title: Animal Science S1 - "Keystone Species"
programme.desc: Explore a wide range of animals from both land and sea. Learn how the anteater can consume nearly 10,000 insects each day, and discover why the walrus is regarded as a keystone species in the Pacific Northwest.

programme.title: Second Chance Pets S2 - "Tug On My Heart"
programme.desc: Jackson, a white Golden puppy, gets a last-minute chance to save his leg, while senior farm dog Tug finds hope and a second chance at life.

programme.title: Second Chance Pets S2 - "Dog Daze"
programme.desc: Draper, born with amniotic band syndrome, gets a front-paw prosthetic. Molly the rescued Pitbull needs a knee brace after getting hurt playing.

programme.title: Second Chance Pets S2 - "Smell the Rosies"
programme.desc: Rosie the Pug, rescued from China, gets a new prosthetic with Katie’s help. Bailey the Lab gets a brace so she can keep enjoying her walks.

programme.title: Blue Realm S1 - "Reefs of Steel"
programme.desc: Around the globe, thousands of decommissioned naval vessels rot in dockyards. What can you do with these toxic time bombs? One solution is to clean them well, blow them up and sink them!

programme.title: Blue Realm S1 - "Shark Nation"
programme.desc: There's no doubt sharks have an image problem. And they're certainly in trouble globally. The population of some species has declined by more than 90% due to over fishing.

programme.title: Race of Life S1 - "Survival of the Fittest"
programme.desc: Animals adapt for survival. Crocodiles, ancient and resilient, boast slow metabolism and efficient physiology. Sharks retain successful traits over time. Whales, from land to sea, evolve with echolocation and robust anatomy, ensuring survival.

programme.title: Race of Life S1 - "The Big Cats"
programme.desc: Cheetahs race towards endangerment.Leopards thrive as opportunistic hunters.Lions reign atop the food chain. Snow leopards navigate treacherous terrain.Tigers persevere. Each big cat surviving maturity claims victory in life's relentless race.

programme.title: Race of Life S1 - "The Great Desert Race"
programme.desc: Deserts, harsh and arid, challenge life with scant rainfall. Desert animals adapt to conserve water, relying on food for hydration. They seek shade, burrow, or became nocturnal to survive extreme temperatures.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes S1 - "Jonathan Franzen"
programme.desc: Jonathan Franzen, the bestselling author and enthusiastic birdwatcher not only familiarizes us with the birdlife, but also discusses the far-reaching consequences of the drastic decline in birds on a global scale and what we can do to save them.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes S1 - "Lydia Moecklinghoff"
programme.desc: Lydia Möcklinghoff, a renowned anteater researcher, has dedicated her life to the protection and study of these fascinating creatures.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes S1 - "Maria Diekmann"
programme.desc: The Californian Maria Diekmann founded the Rare and Endangered Species Trust, REST in short, to provide care for injured and endangered animals.

programme.title: Killer Instincts S1 - "Kitty, NO"
programme.desc: From cheetahs to snow leopards to tigers, witness the deadly precision, speed, and power of nature’s most magnificent big cats.

programme.title: Wild Iberia S1 - "Winter"
programme.desc: The unknown face of Spain. Snow, rain, clouds and cold envelop the land. The ibex migrate to the valleys, and wolves patrol the mountains as vultures circle the skies overhead.

programme.title: Animal Society S1 - "Cats"
programme.desc: The great cats are a group of apex predators that rest firmly at the top of the food chain. Lions, leopards and tigers all live uniquely with particular hunting prowess, advantages and pack hierarchy or solitary territories.

programme.title: Animal Society S1 - "Hooved animals"
programme.desc: Explore the worlds of hooved animals from deer and rhinos to pigs and goats. A diverse collection of some of the most interesting animals in the world.

programme.title: Animal Society S1 - "Fish"
programme.desc: All fish have moveable jaws and are covered in scales, using gills to breath underwater. Many forming schools or shoals based on social structure, it’s a unique group arrangement with many benefits.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Underwater"
programme.desc: While all life began in the oceans, human beings now rely on technology to navigate the seven seas – left to our own devices; we’re like the proverbial fish out of water. Only the other way around.

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Sky"
programme.desc: Animals that live life on the wing, have a vast expanse of sky to navigate, find mates, locate food, and avoid predators in… Living in this aerial realm requires a unique set of senses, specialized to cope with life above ground…

programme.title: Super Senses S1 - "Night"
programme.desc: We find out about the animals that live in the shadows and the adaptations they need to survive. Nocturnal animals have taken to this dark world for good reason. You need some special abilities to cope with the lack of light.

programme.title: Blue World S7 - "Elusive Pajama Squid in South Australia"
programme.sub-title: Elusive Pajama Squid in South Australia
programme.desc: Blue World goes hunting for the rare and elusive Pajama Squid on a night dive off a South Australian jetty. Then correspondent “Cameraman Bill” experiences an ice dive at a frozen lake in New Hampshire.

programme.title: Blue World S7 - "Endangered Angel Sharks in California’s Channel Islands"
programme.sub-title: Endangered Angel Sharks in California’s Channel Islands
programme.desc: Blue World searches for endangered Angel Sharks in California’s Channel Islands; then teams up with world-renown IMAX filmmakers Howard and Michele Hall to film sea turtles feeding in the Philippines.

programme.title: Zoo Clues S3 - "Group Hunters"
programme.desc: Enter the fray with wolf packs, piranha feeding frenzies, and skilled aerial predators to see how group hunters find success.

programme.title: Zoo Clues S3 - "Animals in History"
programme.desc: Uncover the incredible ways that famous animals have partnerned with humans to help shape the course of history.

programme.title: Zoo Clues S3 - "Mischievous Mammals"
programme.desc: Track nature's biggest troublemakers, from creatures that steal eggs from crocodiles to those that dig fake holes to trick predators.

She then launches her own investigation and unearths a twisted web of lies, abuse, and even political conspiracy. Malorie must confront dangerous secrets that not only threaten her sister’s life but her own.

programme.title: The Offer
programme.desc: When Devin and Imani—an estranged couple drowning under financial pressure—receive an unmarked briefcase containing a life-changing sum of money, they find themselves faced with an impossible decision. As tensions rise, secrets unravel, and old wounds reopen, the couple begins to fracture under the moral and emotional weight of the offer.

programme.title: Blind Tiez
programme.desc: Naire is on the up and up as he’s recently promoted to be the youngest detective in the police department. When one of his cases goes completely wrong, he stands accused of murder, and must race to clear his name.

programme.title: Contusion
programme.desc: Terry and his grandmother enjoy a life of peace and harmony, until one night when a group of thieves invade their home. As he navigates from the aftermath, he must confront whether justice will prevail or whether darkness will consume everything he holds dear.

programme.title: Don't Push That
programme.desc: Three friends who all work together at a local video store stumble upon a mysterious device labeled “DPT” which has a mysterious function: predicting the absolute worst possible outcome of any moment or decision. Once the button on the device is pressed, the action can’t be undone, and it must be repeated every 11 minutes to prevent further destruction. The results are equally fun and chaotic.

programme.title: Pastor Thorne: Lust of the Flesh
programme.desc: Pastor Jacob Thorne has a prominent church and a stellar reputation in his city; however, as his fame continues to grow, it is also blinding him causing him to lose focus on what really matters: his family. However, once his son blows into town, his life begins to go on an unexpected whirlwind that could cause his life to take an unwanted spiral downhill.

programme.title: Pastor Thorne 2: Sins of the Father
programme.desc: After losing his church and his family, Pastor Jacob Thorne returns to his roots; however, he soon realizes that returning home also means digging up some ugly truths and dealing with some dark revelations.

programme.title: Magic
programme.desc: The story of a young man growing up in Englewood Chicago through poverty, violence, and adversity. Only to climb up and out of it all to become a success in film and music.

programme.title: Kingsmen
programme.desc: Follows the story of the King family, a known crime syndicate in Dallas. When the beloved patriarch is killed, they fall under the wrath of a rival crime family, as well as local law enforcement. The four eldest brothers will do everything they can to protect their family.

programme.title: A Matter of Heart
programme.desc: Balen, a successful family man, risks everything for a reckless affair. His wife, Krista, faces a harsh reality as her sacrifices are tested. Enter Latricia, a ruthless temptress with no shame. A story that weaves a tale of emotional turmoil, family crisis, unwavering faith, and the destructive power of temptation. Will love or lust prevail?

programme.title: The Betrayal 5: Kutthroat Fa Eva
programme.desc: Love, power, and revenge fuel the war between two rival gangs. As blood spills and alliances crumble, a forbidden romance continues to spark in the chaos. But the streets are buzzing with questions about the updates with TK! Is it all part of the plan, or the beginning of the end?

programme.title: Rhythm and Revenge
programme.desc: After losing her parents, Journi, a talented but troubled teenager, moves in with her aunt and cousin for a fresh start. As she navigates the pressures of competitive dance, strange accidents begin to occur around her. Suspicion grows, but Journi always seems one step ahead, charming her way out of trouble. However, when the truth starts to unravel, danger lurks closer than anyone could have imagined.

programme.title: The Barista
programme.desc: Brandon is a rising star in the podcast world. When he receives an on-air call from Paulette, a local barista, he soon learns that success comes at a price, as Paulette works to interject herself into a every aspect of his life, and sabotaging his success in the process in her ultimate goal to be his number one in all aspects of his life.

programme.title: The Loyalty Test
programme.desc: Trey Harrison is an up-and-coming internet star that has created a series exposing cheaters in orchestrated sting operations, successfully turning heartbreak into a viral spectacle. But when two participants are found murdered, Trey’s world begins to crumble and things only begin to escalate.

programme.title: The Miracle of Tonya Pinkins
programme.desc: A musical biographical documentary about the life, times and career of Tony Award winner and Broadway performing star Tonya Pinkins (Jelly’s Last Jam, Play On, Caroline or Change) the movie chronicles her beginning as a professional child actress in Chicago to an award winning Broadway star, along with the stories and songs that made her one of America’s top performing artists.

programme.title: Till Lies Do Us Part
programme.desc: Amina and Alex announce their engagement to their family and friends after only dating for six months, and are having a destination wedding at that. As the romantic and loving getaway goes along, betrayals and hidden truths come to the surface causing chaos and drama.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Manuela exige que Ricardo reconozca al hijo de Celia, pero él se deprime y le niega el divorcio. Katiuska toma el control de los negocios Tariffi y conspira con Néstor. Hortensia intercepta una carta de Misael y busca expulsar a Manuela de la casa. Marcelo miente a María del Pilar sobre su divorcio, mientras Gustavo recae en el alcohol. La situación se tensa cuando Misael y Gustavo buscan a Manuela, quien permanece retenida por Ricardo en la mansión.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Adolfo entrega a Consuelo la dirección donde se hospeda Blanca. Blanca revela a José Luis que Eustoquio es hijo de Erasto y Arminda. Junior invita a Rosa al cine. Erasto confiesa a Arminda que está enamorado de Consuelo, paralizando a Natalia que lo escucha. Consuelo llega a la residencia y al verse cara a cara con Blanca, esta se desmaya. Mildred busca a René para auxiliarla. Rosa se niega a salir con Junior por preocupación. Adolfo cuenta a Salvador la situación. Chencha revela a Rosa que Consuelo es hija de Blanca.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Oriana sigue enojada con Leo y se niega a hacerle un favor. Por lo que Leo y Jorgito siguen pensando cómo conseguir una muestra para la prueba de ADN. Alejandra se traga su orgullo y le tiene que pedir a Maribel que vuelva a la empresa, quien pone condiciones para retomar su cargo. Paula no logra hablar con Leonardo sobre el embarazo de Irene, así que le da la información a Gloria, quien se la pasa a Rebeca. Irene le comunica a Leonardo que ya firmó la anulación del matrimonio. María Lucía va a hablar con Rodrigo y confirma que es su padre. Virginia acepta cenar con Carlos Ernesto y acude a Zulay y a Sandra para que la ayuden a prepararse. También Jimena acepta cenar con Adolfo.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro visita a Sol en la clínica, donde la dueña del laboratorio lleva los exámenes de ADN para determinar si Alejandro es el padre de Esperanza.Los resultados son negativos, y Alejandro se molesta, pensando que el hijo es en verdad de Heriberto. Pero Sol envió a hacer otro análisis con la prueba de ADN de Heriberto, y esta prueba también resulta negativa. - Por otro lado, Sol comienza a sospechar que Heriberto tuvo que ver con el atentado que ella sufrió, y que la dejó hospitalizada.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En el local nocturno Oscar D`León compromete a Wilker a revelarle el motivo de su inspiración basándose en la presencia de Solimar y Yubiri quienes se muestran emocionadas al recibir la llegada del ídolo de la salsa | Wilker intenta disimular su intención al presentar a Solimar ante Oscar como su novia dejando así a Yubiri en el segundo plano de ser su amiga a pesar de mostrarse evidentemente interesado por la muchacha que logro realmente conquistar su amor.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Carlos Ernesto y Virginia tienen una cita y van a comer a un restaurante. Ella se siente completamente halagada por las palabras de Carlos Ernesto. Al mismo tiempo, Adolfo y Jimena salen a comer para hablar sobre la muerte de Finol y cómo afecta esto los intereses de la familia Ferrándiz. Estas dos parejas se encuentran y Jimena maltrata a Virginia por su pasado por lo que esta se va ofendida. Carlos Ernesto se molesta mucho con Jimena. Virginia va a la casa de Zulay, a contar lo sucedido en la noche, donde esta y su hija Sandra la consuelan y tratan de hacerla sentirse mejor consigo misma. María Lucía habla con Irene para conseguir más datos sobre la verdadera identidad de su padre, pero Irene no le quiere decir nada por respeto a las decisiones de la madre de María Lucía.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor

Como ese resultado es imposible, comienza a sospechar que es un nuevo juego de Reina para lograr que se separe de Alejandro, pero en la búsqueda de la verdad se encontrara con una inesperada sorpresa que cambiara su vida para siempre. Columba va de visita a la oficina de Eloy para llevarle su desayuno, cuando de repente la situación se torna tensa.

Communism in Decline: From Sputnik to Gorbachev
programme.desc: If the space race was about being the first country to put a gleaming satellite into orbit high above the Earth, the Soviets won that race in October 1957. Discover why historians call Sputnik's success the high-water mark of the prestige and confidence of international communism. What made the communists so sure they alone had the keys to the future of human destiny?

programme.title: Communism in Decline: From Sputnik to Gorbachev
programme.desc: In the 1950s and ‘60s, in a clear turn from Stalin's methods, the Soviets planned to win developing countries over to communism by the shining example of the Soviet Union and by its direct help. But reality turned out to be a bit more complicated. Explore the complex relationship between the Soviet Union and Cuba—as well as its burgeoning rivalry with China.

programme.title: Communism in Decline: From Sputnik to Gorbachev
programme.desc: Beginning with its invasion of Czechoslovakia in 1968, the Soviets became deeply embroiled in one country after the next, with each gain bringing increasing problems. Explore whether it's possible to identify a singular decision that tipped the Soviets over the edge from expansion into decline—or were there many? And how did these Soviet decisions affect their long-term rivalry with China?

programme.title: Communism in Decline: From Sputnik to Gorbachev
programme.desc: The communist cultural model is about overcoming the past to make way for the building of a new civilization. Culture was never to be an end in itself, but it would exist solely to serve the communist agenda. Explore the many conflicts this ideology presented in places with a long history of myriad arts. Follow the fascinating trajectories of several artists and writers.

programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: Paul and Perry kick off an adventurous journey down the Ivanhoe River, heading toward a lake that’s known to deliver steady walleye action. But this time, the fish had other plans. With walleye proving tough to track down, the duo turns to the river’s reliable residents—Northern Pike—to keep the rods bending and the spirits high. Surrounded by stunning scenery, flowing rapids, and beautiful waterfalls, this river run becomes more than just a fishing trip—it’s a reminder that the North’s wild beauty always makes the day worthwhile, no matter what’s biting.

programme.desc: A pesar de su asombrosa desventaja, Yugi provoca audazmente a PaniK: "Acabaré contigo en tres turnos". ¿Es un farol de Yugi o tiene ventaja en esta batalla de ingenio?

programme.desc: ¡Kaiba baja al reino para enfrentarse a Pegasus! ¿Ha cambiado Kaiba desde su batalla con Yugi o sigue siendo un duelista despiadado? Una batalla entre el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules de Kaiba y el Dragón B de Ojos Rojos de Joey tiene las respuestas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El campo de las almas perdidas: Parte 1

programme.sub-title: El campo de las almas perdidas: Parte 2

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Atrapados en la cueva del laberinto, Yugi y sus amigos encuentran una salida alternativa, pero la puerta está custodiada por los Hermanos Paradox de Pegasus.

programme.desc: Yugi y Joey aúnan sus fuerzas y consiguen ahuyentar a los monstruos de sus oponentes, pero las cosas están a punto de cambiar cuando los hermanos Paradox invocan al todopoderoso Guardián de la Puerta, ¡un monstruo que refleja todos los ataques!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y Joey liberan cada uno su monstruo más fuerte, Calavera Invocada y Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos, pero su fuerza palidece en comparación con el tremendo poder del Guardián de la Puerta.

programme.desc: Yugi y Joey liberan cada uno su monstruo más fuerte, Calavera Invocada y Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos, pero su fuerza palidece en comparación con el tremendo poder del Guardián de la Puerta.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Utilizando la magia del Ojo del Milenio, Pegasus atrapa el alma de Mokuba dentro de una carta ante la mirada de Kaiba. Para ganarse el derecho a desafiar a Pegasus, Kaiba debe vencer primero a Yugi y hacerse con sus Fichas Estelares.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba convoca al Dragón Máximo de Ojos Azules, el monstruo más fuerte del juego compuesto por tres Dragones Blancos de Ojos Azules. Yugi ha perdido todos sus poderosos Monstruos de Duelo, pero un verdadero duelista nunca se rinde.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi comienza a hilar una estrategia para acabar con el Dragón Máximo de Ojos Azules, pero debe decidir si reclama la victoria o le perdona la vida a Kaiba. El corazón de Yugi está dividido.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi ha perdido sus Fichas Estelares y su única oportunidad de salvar al abuelo, y está en shock. ¿Podrá Téa hacer que Yugi recupere la conciencia derrotando a Mai para conseguir sus Fichas Estelares extra y enseñar a Yugi el corazón del duelista?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos entran en el castillo y descubren que Kaiba se está preparado para batirse en duelo con Pegaso y que el alma de Mokuba pende de un hilo. El poder del Ojo del Milenio otorga a Pegaso la capacidad de leer la mente de los demás.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba está indefenso ante la baraja del Mundo de Dibujos Animados de Pegaso y sus habilidades para leer la mente. Al final del duelo, Pegasus aprisiona el alma de Kaiba en una carta, al igual que hizo con el abuelo y Mokuba. Yugi está harto.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Era la noche anterior a la batalla final, ¡y muchas criaturas se agitan! Yugi jura derrocar a Pegaso por el bien de su abuelo. Tristán lidera un grupo de exploración para descubrir los secretos de Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Bajo la pesada mirada de Pegasus, Yugi se distrae en su duelo con Mai. Después de cometer errores tácticos tontos y permitir que Mai obtenga una gran ventaja con su Dragón Mascota de Arpía, ¿recuperará Yugi su concentración o sucumbirá a tanta presión?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Mai se ha recuperado de su anterior derrota contra Joey convirtiéndose en una mejor duelista. ¿Ha aprendido Yugi de su derrota contra Kaiba, o la derrota emocional sigue pesando en su corazón? La respuesta está en las cartas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey busca frenéticamente la carta que le permite entrar en la batalla final, sin darse cuenta de que Bandido Keith se la ha robado. Mientras intenta aceptar el hecho de que Serenity estará ciega para siempre, recibe la ayuda de un nuevo amigo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La baraja Máquina de Bandido Keith obliga a Joey a ponerse a la defensiva. Joey copia la estrategia de Keith para metalizar su Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos. ¿Está asegurada la victoria, o el tramposo Bandido Keith tiene una última carta en la manga?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El mejor amigo, el mejor duelista: Parte 1
programme.desc: Orgulloso de su fuerza como duelista en el juego, Joey desafía a Yugi para tener derecho a enfrentarse a Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El mejor amigo, el mejor duelista: Parte 2
programme.desc: Yugi se horroriza cuando Joey utiliza la carta del Mago del Tiempo contra él, ¡la misma carta que él le dio a Joey en señal de amistad!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 1
programme.desc: Yugi se prepara para la batalla definitiva contra Pegaso, las almas del abuelo, Kaiba y Mokuba están en juego. Tristán y Bakura se cuelan en el castillo para encontrar a los hermanos Kaiba. ¿Se volverá a convertir Bakura en su yo malvado?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 2
programme.desc: Pegasus usa la baraja de Dibujos Animados y la capacidad de leer la mente que usó con Kaiba y pone a los monstruos de Yugi en su contra. Yugi pierde la voluntad de luchar. ¿Encerrará Pegaso el alma de Yugi en una carta como hizo con Kaiba?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 3
programme.desc: Yugi ha averiguado cómo contrarrestar la capacidad de leer la mente de Pegasus: Yugi se mueve entre sus dos almas y es capaz de destruir el Mundo Dibujos Animados de Pegasus, pero aún no ha empezado el mortal Juego de las Sombras.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 4
programme.desc: Yugi se desploma agotado bajo el poder paralizante del Juego de Sombras. Sus amigos le gritan desesperados ánimos, pero sus voces no penetran en la esfera de oscuridad. La oportunidad de victoria de Yugi se está esfumando, al igual que su vida.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 5
programme.desc: Pegasus invoca a Perdido, un temible monstruo que consume los Monstruos de Duelo de Yugi. Yugi contraataca con... ¿Kuriboh? ¿La criatura más pequeña y débil del juego? ¿Se ha rendido Yugi o se trata de una última estrategia para obtener la victoria?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos regresan del Reino de los Duelistas y se encuentran con una joven llamada Rebecca que exige que el abuelo le devuelva el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules. Ha venido a recuperar la carta que el abuelo le robó hace muchos años.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Rebecca cree por equivocación que el abuelo le robó el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules. Yugi debe defender al Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules para enseñarle que lo que cuenta no es el poder de las cartas, sino el corazón que hay en ellas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Con sus engaños, el Consejo de Administración de KaibaCorp atrapa a Kaiba dentro de un juego de realidad virtual. Mokuba recluta a Yugi y Joey para liberar a Kaiba de este juego definitivo en el que perder equivale a morir.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La búsqueda de Kaiba continúa con un poco de ayuda de... ¿Mai? Pero, ¿podrán Yugi y sus amigos adaptarse a un mundo virtual en el que las reglas y las estrategias cambian a cada paso?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos rescatan a Kaiba, ¡pero siguen atrapados en el juego! La única salida es superar al Dragón de Cinco Cabezas, pero en el difícil duelo, ¡Joey, Mokuba y Mai pierden todos sus puntos de vida!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 1
programme.desc: Un nuevo estudiante, Duke Devlin, derrota a Joey en una partida de Duelo de Monstruos, obligando a Joey a convertirse en su sirviente. Duke obliga a Joey a ponerse un disfraz de perro y lo humilla en público, obligando a Yugi a retar a Duke a un duelo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 2
programme.desc: A cambio de la libertad de Joey, Yugi se juega renunciar a los Duelos de Monstruos para siempre. Yugi tiene un comienzo difícil. Todo empeora cuando Duke revela que ha diseñado los Dados Monstruos de la Mazmorra con la ayuda de Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 3
programme.desc: Yugi utiliza sus habilidades innatas para el juego para dar la vuelta a la tortilla, pero Duke tiene una regla más que mencionar: Todas las criaturas ocupan territorio en el tablero cuadriculado.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 4
programme.desc: Después de que el todopoderoso Orgoth el Despiadado de Duke haga trizas a todo el plantel de monstruos de Yugi, a Yugi solo le queda un turno antes de perder todos sus puntos de corazón.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Un adivino misterioso roba el Rompecabezas del Milenio, y Yugi debe derrotarlo en un duelo para recuperarlo. Sin embargo, no se trata de un adivino cualquiera; es un conocido y formidable enemigo del Reino de los Duelistas... ¿o no?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La misteriosa amenaza que controla a Bandido Keith rompe el Rompecabezas del Milenio en pedazos antes de incendiar la arena de duelos. ¿Podrá Yugi recomponer el Rompecabezas del Milenio y salvar al espíritu antes de que las llaman envuelvan toda la sala?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Se revela el origen de Duelo de Monstruos! Utilizando la magia del Collar del Milenio, la historiadora egipcia Ishizu Ishtar muestra a Kaiba cómo se jugaba al Duelo de Monstruos hace milenios.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El espíritu del Rompecabezas del Milenio ve que han desaparecido sus recuerdos del antiguo Egipto, pero Téa le ayudará a descubrir los misterios de su pasado. El duelista Johnny Steps y sus monstruos musicales del rock interrumpirán su búsqueda.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Para afrontar el futuro, Yugi debe mirar el pasado. Yugi fue un poderoso faraón que salvó al mundo hace cinco milenios. Kaiba pone a prueba los poderes ocultos de su carta egipcia Obelisco el Atormentador contra la furia del Dragón Máximo de Ojos Azules.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Acechado por los Cazadores de Rarezas
programme.desc: Un grupo de siniestros Cazadores de Rarezas acorralan a Joey y le obligan a batirse en duelo. Si Joey pierde, los Cazadores de Rarezas se quedan con su Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos. Joey aplasta a sus enemigos, pero hay otros caminos a la victoria.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra el Cazador de Rarezas, Parte 1: Comienza la ciudad de las batallas
programme.desc: Es hora de aprender nuevas reglas y monstruos. ¡Que comience el Torneo de la Ciudad de la Batalla! En el primer duelo del torneo, Yugi desafía al Cazador de Rarezas para recuperar el Dragón B. de Ojos Rojos de Joey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra el Cazador de Rarezas, Parte 2: Contra Exodia
programme.desc: Yugi descubre la estrategia del Cazador de Rarezas para invocar al todopoderoso Exodia, ¡pero es demasiado tarde para detenerlo! El Cazador de Rarezas ya tiene cuatro piezas de Exodia en su mano, y la quinta y última pieza está encima de su mazo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
